name: @aep/contracts
description: Hand-authored cross-service contracts, and the source of truth they are generated FROM: the aep-api public and internal OpenAPI specs (api/v1, api/internal/v1) plus the shared phase prompts (prompts/). Edit the spec, then run `make gen-api` in services/aep-api and `make gen` at the root to regenerate the server interface and the TS clients — never the other way round.
